rationale: The task requests changes to an existing AGDF repository, but no approved durable UR or other control-state decision is present. Under the fail-closed transition model, the earliest permissible stage is UR; Brownfield Review, path selection, analysis, implementation, and later gates remain unavailable.
decision_grounds: The task is change intent affecting installation stability and parser/transition integrity in an existing AGDF system.
Control-state context explicitly states that no approval or Brownfield decision is present.
The canonical transition model routes a request with no approved UR to UR.
No eventual delivery path is evaluated because Brownfield Review and a visible evidenced Mode/Slice Decision have notlue
